Findings triage (first grading) — **HOLD: `finding` retained.**

**Premise check on `origin/main` @ `cdc0e44`**: warning source verified at `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/div.tsx:17-24` (`console.warn` gated on `NODE_ENV !== 'production'`, no dedup); catalog hit count re-measured at **47** files containing `"type": "div"` under `examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas` (card says 48 — one example has evidently been touched since filing; the surface stands).

**Why hold**: dev-build-only console noise — production docs-site users see nothing, so no user hits this today. The real cost is authoring-contract quality (48 catalog exemplars demonstrating a type the engine itself deprecates, and AI-generated metadata copying them) plus the missing once-semantics burying real errors during dev — both true, neither urgent, and the card correctly notes they are **two separate decisions** (content swap of 47 examples vs adding warn-dedup to the renderer family).

**Restart conditions — any one promotes**:
1. A sweep-pack forms: the 47-example content swap is naturally one sweep card (one claim, one PR, mechanical `div` → layout-component replacement per the warning's own guidance) — promote when a sweep batch is assembled rather than as a lone card;
2. The `div`/`span` deprecation graduates to removal or a hard error — at that point the catalog breaks outright;
3. A second dev-noise incident is recorded where the un-deduped warning buries a real error (first one already logged: #3903's nested-button errors) — that promotes the once-semantics half on its own.

**Dedup**: repo-scoped search on schema-catalog `div` deprecation / DivRenderer — clean; #3903 / PR #3964 (discovery site) changed the card shell only.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

**背景**:catalog 189 个 `div` 节点中 83 个(26 文件)在现有词表无非废弃对等物(纯装饰盒/无 className 分组包装,五个建议替代品全部注入类,唯一透传的 semantic 组是 landmark 元素);且 `div` 结构上**不可退役** —— `kind:'html'` 层解析器把 div 标签原样编译成 `{"type":"div"}`(os-parser 三处 file:line 实证,另见 #4000)。「零 div」在本仓永远无法成为不变量。

**待拍板(两轴分析详见 PR3998)**:
- **A. 补中性容器类型(如 `box`)**:registry + types schema + docs + parser 白名单;此后 189 节点 `div`→`box` 是零渲染差异机械替换。长期唯一把废弃契约做完的选项;作者面拿到名字即语义的类型。代价:新增公共类型。
- **B. 收窄废弃**:html-tier 解析产物不再报废弃,承认残余 `div` 合法。诚实且便宜,但留下「废弃类型永久合法」的含糊态。
- **C. 强推 semantic 标签:实施 agent 与 PM 一致明确不推荐**(把 landmark 当通用盒子写进 45 个范本,第二轴为负)。

**推荐**(采实施 agent 分析):**短期 B、长期 A** —— 两轴同向,真正的选择只是「现在投多少 A」。

**已先行的部分**(不等决策):①warn 去重已落 PR #3998(合并会自动关本单,PM 将随即重开保留本标签);②106 个明确布局意图节点的 prop 转换在任何终态下都成立 —— 已拆独立实施单先派;③div.mdx 的 2 个刻意 legacy 示例在任何选项下永久豁免(PR3998 评论在案)。

### First action: re-measure, the card is a week old

The card counts **48 examples still using the deprecated `div` component type**. That number was taken when the card was filed. ⛔ Do not quote it — re-derive it on today's `origin/main` and report the current figure, with a positive control in the same query shape so a smaller number is a measurement rather than a broken pattern.

⚠️ `examples/schema-catalog` was edited today by PR #6667 (two `fields-location` schemas). Cut from a fresh `origin/main`.

### What actually needs deciding before the edit

The card's value is that every docs-site thumbnail currently emits a deprecation warning. But **what `div` should become is not stated on the card**, and it is not this seat's to guess:

- if there is exactly one supported replacement and the deprecation notice names it, this is mechanical — do it, and quote the notice;
- if the replacement depends on how each example uses `div` (layout container vs. bare wrapper vs. styling hook), then the mapping is per-example and you must show the mapping you used rather than applying one blindly;
- if `div` turns out **not** to be deprecated on today's ref, report `premise_still_valid: false` and stop.

⭐ The deliverable that makes this stick is not the 48 edits — it is whether anything **stops the 49th** from being written. Say what you found on that, even if the answer is "nothing does, and closing that is a separate card."

### ⛔ Fences

Held this batch: `packages/app-shell` (#6535, #6559), `packages/i18n` (#6610), `packages/plugin-grid` (PR #6670), `packages/types` + `renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` (PR #6673), `packages/sdui-parser` + `packages/plugin-list` (#6598).

⛔ Do not "fix" the `div` renderer itself — that is a published component and a different card. This card moves **examples**.

## ✅ ACCEPT — `premise_still_valid: false`, zero edits, and that is the right delivery. → `needs-user-decision`

`domain:ui` @ objectui execution seat, PM session `8ca04858-ea8e-5b85-9182-de59aa49e00c`. `pm:dispatched` → `needs-user-decision`, assignee cleared, in the same stroke as this comment. No PR, no branch commit, no example edited.

### The card's two headline facts are both false on today's ref

| the card says | measured on `origin/main` `f55d6661` |
| --- | --- |
| 48 examples still use `div` | **27 files / 85 nodes** |
| every docs thumbnail emits a deprecation warning | **one notice per corpus render, not one per thumbnail** |

The second is the card's whole stated symptom, and **PR #3998 already fixed it** with once-per-module-load dedup. Measured by rendering all catalog entries through the real `SchemaRenderer` with a `console.warn` spy: `entries_rendered=428, total_warns=4, div_notices=1`. ⭐ The other three warns (react-i18next, a `visibleWhen` predicate, an expression failure) are the **positive control** — they prove the spy was capturing, so `div_notices=1` is a measurement and not a silent spy.

The migratable half also already shipped, as **#4003** (closed 2026-08-17): `div` 189 → 86 while `flex` 164 → 248 and `stack` 145 → 153, corpus unchanged at 423 files — migration, not deletion. Population counts carry their own control: `card` = 93 nodes at every ref measured (08-10, 08-18, 08-28), so the `div` drop is real and not a broken pattern.

### ⚠️ Which means the 2026-08-25 ruling was almost certainly taken on a stale premise

That ruling approved **"Option A — migrate all 48"** against a card that still said 48. The mechanically migratable ~106 had landed **eight days earlier** in #4003. So the ruling authorised a sweep whose migratable half was already done, and what it actually authorises today is a sweep over the **residue** — which, per below, is empty.

⇒ This is a **re-scope of #3965, not a new sweep**, and that is why it comes back to you rather than being executed.

### Why not one of the 85 was touched

All 85 residual nodes are `display:block` bare boxes, and **none of the replacements the deprecation notice itself names is one-to-one for a block box** — every one injects layout:

| candidate | what it injects |
| --- | --- |
| `container` | `w-full max-w-xl mx-auto p-2 sm:p-3 md:p-4` |
| `stack` / `flex` | `flex` plus direction / justify / align / gap |
| `grid` | `grid grid-cols-*` |
| `card` | `rounded-lg border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm`, **and wraps children in `CardContent`** |

`cn()` is `twMerge`, so an authored `className` wins a *conflicting* utility — **but nothing in a className can undo an injected `display:flex`**, and 0 of the 85 nodes carry a flex/grid display class. Under your 2026-08-25 escape clause the entire remaining population is excluded, so the approved sweep has nothing left to sweep. The dev made **no edits rather than force-fitting them**, which is the correct call.

## 四维分析 — 决策卡面

**待裁的问题**：这 27 个目录范例仍在把一个引擎已废弃的类型教给作者（人和 AI 都读它们）。而今天的词汇表里**没有任何一个中性块盒**可以一对一替换。怎么收口？

| | **A. 新增中性 `box` 类型（dev 建议，本席同意）** | **B. 收窄 deprecation，承认裸块盒合法** | **C. 改成语义标签 section/article/aside** |
|---|---|---|---|
| | registry + types + docs + parser allowlist 各加一处；85 个节点随后是**零渲染差异**的机械替换，`div` 在 JSON 面才算真退役 | 保留现状，把这 85 个从报告里排除 | 唯一 class-transparent 的家族（`semantic.tsx` 只渲染 Tag + className，不注入任何东西） |
| **① 实际业务需求** | ⭐ 27 个范例停止教废弃类型；替换是机械的，无渲染差异 | 便宜、诚实，零工作量 | 技术上一对一，但把 landmark 当通用盒子 |
| **② 项目长远合理性** | ⭐ 补上词汇表里本就缺的那一格——`div` 之所以退不掉，正是因为没有替代品 | ⛔ 留下「一个废弃类型永久合法」，declared≠enforced 的另一种形态 | ⛔ 语义标签被稀释成布局容器，可访问性面被污染 |
| **③ 防 AI 写错元数据** | ⭐ 最强：AI 抄范例时抄到的是受支持的类型 | ✗ AI 继续从 27 个范例里抄到废弃类型 | ⛔ **最差**：AI 会把 `section`/`article` 当 div 用，且这会被逐字复制进生成的 metadata |
| **④ 创业阶段不扩散需求** | 一个新公开类型 —— 有成本，但**有界**，且 2026-08-09 的升级早就长期建议过它（确认：今天 `box` 未注册，`"type": "box"` 目录里 0 命中） | ⭐ 零成本 | 零新类型，但代价转嫁到可访问性 |

**本席建议 A。** 理由是 ③：本卡存在的价值从来不是控制台噪音（#3998 已修，实测每次语料渲染只剩 1 条），而是**27 个范例在教一个引擎已废弃的类型**。B 让它们永远教下去；C 用一个更坏的教学替换一个坏的。⛔ C 被 2026-08-09 的实现 agent、当时的 PM 与本轮 dev 三方独立反对，本席同意。

⛔ **A 新增一个公开授权类型，属 clause-② 且落人工地板，本席不代裁。**

### ⭐ 附带发现：没有任何东西能拦住第 49 个

已单独立卡（见下方链接）。摘要：两道碰组件类型的门禁都只问「这个 type 解析得出来吗」，从不问「它是不是已废弃」——目录渲染测试实证 **85 个 `div` 在场，583/583 全绿**。而且这比常见的「声明了但无处强制」更糟一层：**这个废弃根本没有机器可读的声明**。`RegistryComponentMetaExtras` 带 `tier` / `namespace` / `skipFallback` / `labelAssociation`，**没有 `deprecated` 字段**；整个「div 已废弃」只存在于 `div.tsx` 的一句 `console.warn` 字面量和人读标签「Container (Deprecated)」里。

⇒ 若那条被做掉，**A 方案自带强制**：新范例再写 `div` 会当场变红，而不是等下一次人工普查。这也是为什么本席认为 A 与那张卡应当一起看。

## Premise re-verified on the merged ref — defect still real, the count is not

`domain:ui` execution seat, session `session_01CRJge11jso9TpXRWFt1Z49`. ⛔ Not claimed, no label change — recording a measurement so the next dispatch is priced against the code rather than the title.

This card was held out of a batch because it collided with PR #6721, which touched `examples/schema-catalog/src/catalog-meta.json` and `src/index.ts`. #6721 merged at 03:01Z as `9486ac672`.

**Measured on `9486ac672`: 27 files under `examples/schema-catalog` contain `"type": "div"`.** The title says 48.

⚠️ I am not claiming 21 were fixed. The two numbers may simply be counting different things — 48 occurrences versus 27 files, or a scope that has since narrowed. **Whoever takes this should establish which unit the 48 was, and re-count in that unit**, rather than inheriting either figure. The defect itself is unchanged and still present: those fixtures author a deprecated component type, and every docs-site thumbnail built from them logs a deprecation warning.

### Also worth knowing before pricing this

- **The catalog is an actively edited surface.** #6721 added three fixtures and touched `catalog-meta.json` and `index.ts` in the same PR. A mechanical sweep across 27 files will conflict with anything else in flight there, so it wants a clear run rather than a slot alongside another catalog card.
- **Check what `div` should become before sweeping.** A find-and-replace to whatever the current container type is would be the obvious move and the wrong one if the replacement is not a drop-in — the fixtures are rendered as thumbnails, so a wrong container changes what the docs site shows without failing any test.

### What was measured

**The count was in the wrong unit, and the real one has moved.** The card's own query was `grep -rl … | wc -l`, so its **48 counted FILES**. Re-counted in that same unit on `9486ac672`: **27 files, 85 nodes**.

⭐ And the drop was validated rather than assumed: a positive control in the identical query shape, `"type": "card"`, returns **93 nodes / 53 files** — the same 93 measured on 08-10, 08-18 and 08-28. So `48 → 27` is a **real migration** (#4003 moved 106 nodes on 08-17), not a broken pattern.

**The stated symptom is already gone.** The card says the docs site logs "a deprecation warning per thumbnail". Rendering all 431 entries through the real `SchemaRenderer` with a `console.warn` spy live from the first entry:

```
entries_rendered=431   total_warns=4   div_deprecation_notices=1
```

**One** notice for the whole corpus — `DivRenderer` reports once per module load (#3998) and exempts `kind:'html'` by provenance (#4000). The other three warns are the spy's own positive control.

⚠️ Worth keeping: the first census read **0**, because an earlier test in the same file had already latched the once-per-module-load guard. A census sharing a module instance with any other `div` render is not measuring the corpus.

### ⛔ Why the sweep did not run

The 2026-08-29 ruling's acceptance criterion is *"browser spot-verification that renders are unchanged."* **That cannot be satisfied.** Measured through the real renderers on identical authored input:

- `div` is **class-transparent** — it emits the authored `className` verbatim and nothing else.
- Every replacement the deprecation names injects layout: `container` adds `w-full max-w-xl mx-auto sm:p-3 md:p-4`, `flex`/`stack` add display+gap, `grid` adds `grid-cols-2 gap-4`, `card` adds border/shadow **and wraps children in an extra `CardContent`**.
- ⚠️ `twMerge` does **not** strip `container`'s injected `sm:p-3 md:p-4` — different responsive variants from the authored `p-4` — so the box silently gets **smaller** padding from `sm` up.
- None of the 85 nodes authors a single layout prop (the only keys across all 85 are `type`, `className`, `children`, `body`), so there is no authored intent to carry over. Every conversion is pure addition.

⭐⭐ **And a second difference that no existing check could catch.** `container`/`flex`/`stack`/`grid` render `schema.children` **only**; `div` renders `schema.children || schema.body` — and **4 of the 85 nodes author `body`**. Measured on the real `basic-sidebar.json`, swapping only its `div`:

```
as authored (div)  elements=21  text="Menu…Settings Main content area"
swapped -> stack   elements=21  text="Menu…Settings"      <- content GONE
```

**The element count is unchanged at 21.** The loss is invisible to any element-count check, and `catalog-gallery-render`'s `drewSomething` control still passes. A find-and-replace would have shipped a silent catalog-wide content regression — worse than the warning it removes.

`section`/`article`/`aside` are the one class-transparent family and are technically one-to-one, but they teach landmark elements as generic boxes across 27 exemplars. Three parties recommended against that independently before this; this measurement makes four.
